rows.text_en: Korea Meteorological Administration ( Innovation Administration & Legal Affairs Division ), 042-481-7304
Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 기상청과 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항부터 제5항까지의 규정에 따라 국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「기상청과 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing levels for auxiliary and advisory agencies established within the Korea Meteorological Administration and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under a director pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 through 5 of the “Government Organization Act,” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.
Chapter 2 Korea Meteorological Administration

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Deputy Administrator) The Deputy Administrator shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 30, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Jan. 12, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(디지털소통팀장) ① 청장 밑에 디지털소통팀장을 둔다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Head of Digital Communication Team) ① A Head of Digital Communication Team shall be appointed under the Commissioner. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

② The head of the Digital Communication Team shall be appointed from among the Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 디지털소통팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 청장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Commissioner in the following matters.
1. Establishment and Operation of Digital Communication & Promotion Plan
2. Operation of digital communication channels

rows.source_ko: 3. 주요 정책에 관한 디지털소통 콘텐츠 제작 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Production and management of digital communication content regarding major policies

rows.source_ko: 4. 온라인 이슈 대응 콘텐츠 제작 및 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Creation and Management of Content for Responding to Online Issues
5. Online promotion of the Commissioner's policy activities

rows.source_ko: 6. 디지털 분야 정책소통 및 정책홍보 점검ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 6. Review and Evaluation of Policy Communication and Promotion in the Digital Sector

[This Article newly inserted Jan. 6, 2026]
[Title amended Mar. 24, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Director of Planning and Coordination) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정관 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정법무담당관ㆍ연구개발담당관 및 국제협력담당관을 두되, 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정법무담당관 및 국제협력담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 연구개발담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 기상연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 8. 10., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 6. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director of Planning and Coordination, there shall be a Planning and Finance Officer, an Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Officer, a Research and Development Officer, and an International Cooperation Officer; wherein the Planning and Finance Officer, the Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Officer, and the International Cooperation Officer shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the Research and Development Officer shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Meteorological Research Officer. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; Aug. 10, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Jun. 25, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2015. 10. 19.>

rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the comprehensive evaluation of the level and quality of meteorological technology

rows.text_en: 4. Coordination of the formulation, settlement, and execution of the internal budget

rows.text_en: 6. Overall management and coordination of National Assembly-related affairs within the Agency

rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the overall management of party-government consultations within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 8. 간부회의, 주요정책에 관한 회의 등 청내 주요회의에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the management of major projects, such as national policy tasks and campaign pledge tasks
10. Matters concerning the management of various instructions

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 관내 다른 담당관의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not assigned to any other officer within the Agency

④ The Officer in Charge of Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs assists the Officer for Planning and Coordination in the following matters. <Amended Apr. 13, 2010; Oct. 16, 2013; Jan. 12, 2015; Jun. 26, 2015; Dec. 30, 2016; Jan. 9, 2018; Mar. 30, 2018; Jul. 27, 2020; Feb. 22, 2022; Jun. 25, 2024>

rows.text_en: 3. Management of Organization and Staffing through Internal Organizational Diagnosis and Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 5. 청내 정부기능분류 관련 업무의 총괄에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the overall management of tasks related to the classification of government functions within the agency

rows.source_ko: 6. 청내 총액인건비제 관련 업무의 총괄에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the overall management of affairs related to the internal total personnel cost system

rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning work coordination among departments within the agency

rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the planning, overall management, and coordination of government performance evaluations within the agency

rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of an internal agency performance management system

17. Matters concerning the overall management of inquiries and responses regarding laws and regulations

rows.text_en: 18. Overall management of litigation affairs and duties regarding administrative appeals
19. Duties regarding regulatory review and maintenance

rows.source_ko: 20. 행정서비스 헌장 제도의 총괄 및 지원
rows.text_en: 20. Overall management and support of the Administrative Service Charter system
21. Overall management of administrative procedure system-related affairs
21-2. Overall Management of the Petition System
22. Improvement of civil complaint-related systems

rows.source_ko: 23. 정부혁신 관련 과제의 발굴ㆍ선정과 추진상황의 확인ㆍ점검 및 관리
rows.text_en: 23. Identification and selection of government innovation-related tasks, and verification, monitoring, and management of implementation status
24. Overall management of affairs related to domestic and international meteorological cooperation agreements

rows.source_ko: 25. 산하 공공기관의 조직ㆍ정원관리 및 경영지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 25. Matters concerning the organization, personnel management, and management support of affiliated public institutions

rows.source_ko: 26. 청 내 국가사무 민간위탁 현황 관리 등 총괄

rows.text_en: 27. Overall management of employment policies within the agency, system improvement, and verification and monitoring of implementation status

rows.source_ko: 28. 청 내 공공기관, 기업, 단체 등과의 행정협업 관련 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 28. Overall management and coordination of administrative collaboration tasks with public institutions, companies, organizations, etc. within the Agency
⑤ Deleted <April 13, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 연구개발담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2015. 1. 12.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Research and Development Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Jan. 12, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 기상업무 및 기상산업 분야 연구개발(이하 “기상연구개발”이라 한다) 사업에 관한 정책, 기본계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, comprehensive management, and coordination of policies and basic plans regarding research and development projects in the fields of meteorological services and the meteorological industry (hereinafter referred to as “meteorological R&D”)
2. Allocation and Adjustment of Meteorological Research and Development Budget (Government Grants and Test Research Expenses)

rows.source_ko: 3. 기상연구개발 사업에 대한 심의ㆍ평가 및 제도개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the deliberation, evaluation, and institutional improvement of meteorological research and development projects

rows.source_ko: 4. 연구용역사업의 심의ㆍ평가 및 제도개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the deliberation, evaluation, and institutional improvement of research service projects
5. Management and Supervision of Meteorological Research and Development Projects

rows.source_ko: 6. 기상연구개발 사업의 성과관리 및 활용촉진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the performance management and promotion of utilization of meteorological research and development projects

rows.source_ko: 7. 기상청 연구관리시스템 구축 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Korea Meteorological Administration's research management system
⑦ The Officer for International Cooperation assists the Officer for Planning and Coordination in the following matters. <Amended Apr. 13, 2010; Oct. 16, 2013; Jan. 12, 2015; Mar. 30, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 기상청 국제협력에 관한 정책 및 기본계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, integration, and coordination of policies and basic plans regarding the Korea Meteorological Administration's international cooperation

rows.source_ko: 2. 세계기상기구 등 국제기구와의 협력업무 청내 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of cooperation with international organizations, such as the World Meteorological Organization, within the agency

rows.source_ko: 3. 동북아 국가와의 기상 및 지진분야 기술협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning technical cooperation with Northeast Asian countries in the fields of meteorology and seismology
4. Matters concerning international exchange and cooperation in meteorological technology

rows.source_ko: 5. 기상분야 국제개발협력 사업의 기획 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and Management of International Development Cooperation Projects in the Meteorological Sector

rows.source_ko: 6. 청내 공무국외여행 및 국외파견에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning official overseas travel and dispatch within the agency

rows.source_ko: 7. 청내 국제회의, 훈련 등의 개최 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the hosting and support of international conferences, training, etc. within the agency

rows.source_ko: 8. 북한지역 기상ㆍ기후 관련 정책의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and coordination of weather and climate-related policies in the North Korean region
9. Deleted <Jan. 12, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 10. 남북한 공동 기상관측망의 구성 및 운영

rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning meteorological agencies in South and North Korea and international cooperation

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(감사담당관) 감사담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Audit Officer) The Audit Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

[This Article newly inserted Apr. 13, 2010]
[Moved from Article 5-2 <May 31, 2012>]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
Article 5-2
[Formerly Article 5-2 moved to Article 4-2 <May 31, 2012>]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(예보국) ① 예보국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2015. 1. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Forecasting Bureau) ① The Director of the Forecasting Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Jan. 12, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 「기상청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제1항에 따라 예보국장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 예보총괄관리관으로 하며, 예보총괄관리관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ② Under Article 10 (1) of the “Organization of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the Forecasting Management Officer shall be placed under the Director of the Forecasting Bureau. The Forecasting Management Officer shall be appointed from among general civil servants in the Senior Civil Service, and the position shall be graded B. <Amended Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 예보총괄관리관은 「기상청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제5호, 제6호, 제7호, 제9호, 제22호 및 제26호의 사항에 관하여 국장을 보좌한다. <신설 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Forecasting Management Officer shall assist the Director of the Bureau in the matters specified in Article 10 (3) 5, 6, 7, 9, 22 and 26 of the “Organization of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly inserted Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 예보국에 예보정책과ㆍ예보기술과ㆍ국가태풍센터ㆍ재해기상대응과 및 총괄예보관 4명을 두며, 예보정책과장ㆍ예보기술과장ㆍ국가태풍센터장ㆍ재해기상대응과장 및 총괄예보관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로 보한다. <신설 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Forecasting Bureau shall have the Forecasting Policy Division, Forecasting Technology Division, National Typhoon Center, Disaster Weather Response Division, and four Chief Forecasters; the Heads of the Forecasting Policy Division, Forecasting Technology Division, National Typhoon Center, and Disaster Weather Response Division, as well as the Chief Forecasters, shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Chief Specialists. <Newly Inserted Jan. 6, 2026>

⑤ The Head of the Forecasting Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 13, 2010; Oct. 16, 2013; Jan. 12, 2015; Oct. 19, 2015; Dec. 30, 2016; Jul. 23, 2019; Jul. 27, 2020; Aug. 10, 2021; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 예보(장기ㆍ수치예보는 제외한다. 이하 이 항, 제4항 및 제9항에서 같다) 및 특보(지진ㆍ지진해일ㆍ화산 특보는 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다) 관련 업무에 관한 기본정책 및 계획의 수립ㆍ종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and management of basic policies and plans regarding work related to forecasts (excluding long-term and numerical forecasts; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph, Paragraphs 4 and 9) and special warnings (excluding earthquake, tsunami, and volcanic special warnings; hereinafter the same applies in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 영향예보 관련 업무에 관한 기본정책 및 계획의 수립ㆍ종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1-2. Establishment, coordination, and integration of basic policies and plans regarding impact forecasting-related tasks

rows.source_ko: 2. 예보 및 특보 관련 제도의 개선

rows.source_ko: 제11조(지방기상청) ① 수도권기상청장ㆍ부산지방기상청장ㆍ광주지방기상청장 및 강원지방기상청장은 각각 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 각각 나등급으로 하고, 대전지방기상청장 및 대구지방기상청장은 각각 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 제주지방기상청장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. 다만, 제주지방기상청장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 4. 13., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 1. 12., 2019. 6. 18., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Regional Meteorological Offices) ① The Directors of the Capital Region Meteorological Office, the Busan Regional Meteorological Office, the Gwangju Regional Meteorological Office, and the Gangwon Regional Meteorological Office shall each be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of their respective positions shall be Grade B. The Directors of the Daejeon Regional Meteorological Office and the Daegu Regional Meteorological Office shall each be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the Director of the Jeju Regional Meteorological Office shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary or Secretary. However, the Director of the Jeju Regional Meteorological Office may be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary assigned and operated through mutual transfer pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Apr. 13, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 12, 2015; Jun. 18, 2019; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 지방기상청에 기획운영과ㆍ예보과ㆍ관측과 및 기후서비스과를 두되, 지방기상청의 기획운영과장은 공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보하고, 수도권기상청ㆍ부산지방기상청ㆍ광주지방기상청 및 강원지방기상청의 예보과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로 보하며, 관측과장 및 기후서비스과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 대전지방기상청 및 대구지방기상청의 예보과장은 각각 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로 보하며, 제주지방기상청의 예보과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 수석전문관으로 보하고, 대전지방기상청ㆍ대구지방기상청 및 제주지방기상청의 관측과장은 각각 공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보하며, 대전지방기상청 및 대구지방기상청의 기후서비스과장은 각각 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보하고, 제주지방기상청의 기후서비스과장은 공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. 다만, 제주지방기상청의 기후서비스과장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제2항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 6. 26., 2015. 10. 19., 2016. 2. 29., 2019. 6. 18., 2019. 12. 31., 2020. 7. 27., 2023. 6. 30., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Regional Meteorological Offices shall establish a Planning and Operations Division, a Forecasting Division, an Observation Division, and a Climate Service Division; wherein the Head of the Planning and Operations Division of a Regional Meteorological Office shall be appointed as an Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer; the Head of the Forecasting Division of the Capital Region Meteorological Office, Busan Regional Meteorological Office, Gwangju Regional Meteorological Office, and Gangwon Regional Meteorological Office shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Senior Specialist; and the heads of the Observation Divisions of the Daejeon, Daegu and Jeju Regional Meteorological Offices shall be appointed as an Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer, respectively; the Head of the Climate Service Division of the Daejeon Regional Meteorological Office and the Daegu Regional Meteorological Office shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer, respectively; and the Head of the Climate Service Division of the Jeju Regional Meteorological Office shall be appointed as an Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer. rows.source_ko: 제13조(국가기상위성센터) ① 국가기상위성센터장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 기상연구관으로 보한다. 다만, 국가기상위성센터장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 4. 13., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 1. 12., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (National Meteorological Satellite Center) ① The Director of the National Meteorological Satellite Center shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, a Senior Secretary, or a Meteorological Research Officer. However, the Director of the National Meteorological Satellite Center may be appointed as a Deputy Director General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, or a Senior Secretary assigned and operated through mutual transfer pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Apr. 13, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 12, 2015; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 국가기상위성센터(이하 이 조에서 “센터”라 한다)에 위성기획과ㆍ위성운영과ㆍ위성분석과 및 위성개발팀을 두되, 위성기획과장 및 위성운영과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 기상연구관으로, 위성분석과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ기상연구관 또는 수석전문관으로, 위성개발팀장은 기상연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2010. 4. 13., 2011. 8. 30., 2012. 5. 31., 2015. 10. 19., 2019. 12. 31., 2020. 5. 4., 2021. 8. 10., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 10. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The National Meteorological Satellite Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Center”) shall have a Satellite Planning Division, a Satellite Operation Division, a Satellite Analysis Division, and a Satellite Development Team; the heads of the Satellite Planning Division and the Satellite Operation Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Meteorological Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Meteorological Research Officer; the head of the Satellite Analysis Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Meteorological Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, Meteorological Research Officer, or Senior Specialist; and the head of the Satellite Development Team shall be appointed as a Meteorological Research Officer. <Amended Apr. 13, 2010; Aug. 30, 2011; May 31, 2012; Oct. 19, 2015; Dec. 31, 2019; May 4, 2020; Aug. 10, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Oct. 25, 2024>

rows.text_en: Article 16 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Korea Meteorological Administration) ① The personnel quota for public officials in the Korea Meteorological Administration by rank is as set forth in Annex 3. rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special Provisions on Effective Dates for Adjustments to Clerical Technical Staff Quotas) Notwithstanding Article 1, the following changes to staffing quotas shall take effect on December 3, 2010: within the Korea Meteorological Administration, a reduction of four technical service positions (one Grade 9 and three Grade 10 clerical support staff) and an increase of four general service positions (three Grade 8 administrative, industrial, meteorological, facilities, computer or broadcasting and telecommunications clerks, and one Grade 9 assistant clerk in any of those categories); and within its affiliated agencies, a reduction of 18 technical service positions (one Grade 9 and 17 Grade 10 clerical support staff) and an increase of 18 general service positions (11 Grade 8 clerks and seven Grade 9 assistant clerks in the corresponding categories).

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사무직렬 기능직공무원 정원조정에 따른 특례) 이 규칙 시행에 따라 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 22명(행정서기ㆍ공업서기ㆍ기상서기ㆍ시설서기ㆍ전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 14, 행정서기보ㆍ공업서기보ㆍ기상서기보ㆍ시설서기보ㆍ전산서기보 또는 방송통신서기보 8)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of technical civil servants in the administrative series)  The 22 general civil servant positions to be increased pursuant to the enforcement of this rule (14 administrative clerks, industrial clerks, meteorological clerks, facility clerks, computer clerks, or broadcasting and telecommunications clerks; 8 assistant administrative clerks, assistant industrial clerks, assistant meteorological clerks, assistant facility clerks, assistant computer clerks, or assistant broadcasting and telecommunications clerks) shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 4의 행정사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 방송통신사무관 1명은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2028년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명으로 본다. <개정 2021. 12. 31., 2023. 12. 12., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① One Administrative Officer, Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer specified in Annex 4, which is adjusted by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027; and thereafter, the corresponding authorized quota shall be deemed to be one Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Meteorological Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant. <Amended Dec. 31, 2021; Dec. 12, 2023; Dec. 31, 2025>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of technical civil servants in the administrative series)  The 24 general civil servant positions (4 administrative clerks, 11 meteorological clerks, 3 assistant administrative clerks, and 6 assistant meteorological clerks) that are increased pursuant to this rule shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Public Officials Appointment Decree No. 21717.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사무직렬 기능직공무원의 정원감축에 따른 경과조치) 이 규칙 에 따라 감축되는 기능직공무원 정원 24명(기능9급 사무실무원 2명, 기능 10급 사무실무원 22명)에 해당하는 기능직공무원의 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 2011년 12월 12일까지 그 초과현원에 상응하는 정원이 이 규칙에 따라 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 24명(행정서기 4명, 기상서기 11명, 행정서기보 3명, 기상서기보 6명)을 대체하여 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Following the Reduction of Quotas for Technical Civil Servants in the Administrative Series)  In the event that there is an excess number of technical civil servants corresponding to the 24 technical civil servant quotas (2 Grade 9 administrative clerks and 22 Grade 10 administrative clerks) being reduced pursuant to this Rule, the quota corresponding to such excess number shall be deemed to have replaced the 24 general civil servant quotas (4 administrative clerks, 11 meteorological clerks, 3 assistant administrative clerks, and 6 assistant meteorological clerks) being increased pursuant to this Rule until December 12, 2011.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기간) ① 별표 4에 따른 행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사ㆍ방송통신주사ㆍ기록연구사 또는 별정직 6급상당의 정원 중 10명은 2014년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2015년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 7명과 행정서기ㆍ공업서기ㆍ시설서기ㆍ전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 3명으로 본다.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사무직렬 기능직공무원의 정원 조정에 관한 특례) 이 규칙에 따라 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 14명(기상주사보 8명, 행정서기보 3명, 기상서기보 3명)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of technical civil servants in the administrative series)  The 14 general civil servant positions (8 assistant meteorological officers, 3 assistant administrative clerks, and 3 assistant meteorological clerks) that are increased pursuant to this rule shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 504, Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제12조제5항의 개정규정은 2014년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 12, Paragraph 5 shall enter into force on January 1, 2014.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 대한 경과조치) 대통령령 제24448호 「기상청과 그 소속기관 직제」 일부개정령 시행으로 이 규칙에 따른 정원을 초과하는 현원 4명(4ㆍ5급 1명, 5급 1명, 6급 1명, 8급 1명)은 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 기상청과 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Regarding Personnel Quotas)  As a result of the enforcement of Presidential Decree No. 24448, the Partial Amendment to the Organizational Structure of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies, the four personnel currently employed who exceed the personnel quota under this Rule (one person in Grade 4 or 5, one person in Grade 5, one person in Grade 6, and one person in Grade 8) shall be deemed to have separate personnel quotas corresponding to them within the Korea Meteorological Administration and its affiliated agencies until the excess personnel quota matches the personnel quota under this Rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 520, Oct. 16, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기간) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 수치자료통합팀 및 기후협력서비스팀은 2015년 1월 11일까지 각각 존속한다. <개정 2015. 1. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Numerical Data Integration Team and the Climate Cooperation Service Team, newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies upon the enforcement of this Rule, shall each remain in existence until January 11, 2015. <Amended Jan. 12, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기간까지 수치자료통합팀장 및 기후협력서비스팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 아니하는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기간이 지난 날부터 수치자료통합팀장이 분장하는 사항은 수치자료응용과장이, 기후협력서비스팀장이 분장하는 사항은 기후예측과장이 각각 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made concerning the responsibilities of the Heads of the Numerical Data Integration Team and the Climate Cooperation Service Team before the end of the period under paragraph (1), from the day following that period the responsibilities of the former shall be assumed by the Head of the Numerical Data Application Division, and those of the latter by the Head of the Climate Prediction Division.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사무직렬 기능직공무원 정원조정에 따른 특례) 이 규칙 시행에 따라 증원되는 일반직 공무원 정원 1명(행정서기보 1명)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of functional civil servants in the administrative series)  One general civil servant position (one administrative assistant) increased pursuant to the enforcement of this rule shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree No. 21717.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 527, Dec. 11, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on December 12, 2013.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 대통령령 제24979호 기상청과 그 소속기관 직제 일부개정령 및 대통령령 제 호 책임운영기관의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행령 일부개정령 시행에 따른 초과현원으로서 이 규칙에 따른 정원을 초과하는 현원 13명(5급 1명, 6급 3명, 7급 3명, 8급 1명, 9급 5명)은 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 기상청과 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  As for the 13 personnel exceeding the personnel quota under this Rule due to the enforcement of Presidential Decree No. 24979, Partial Amendment to the Organizational Structure of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies, and Presidential Decree No. [number omitted in source], Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Responsible Management Agencies, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to exist separately within the Korea Meteorological Administration and its affiliated agencies until the excess personnel quota matches the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능직 폐지에 따른 정원 조정에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 기능직공무원 정원을 감축하여 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 중 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제26조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 통합ㆍ운영하던 정원이 있는 경우에, 그 통합ㆍ운영하던 직급에 근속승진 임용된 공무원에 대해서는 해당 직급에 재직하는 동안에는 별표 3부터 별표 5까지, 별표 5의2, 별표 6부터 별표 8까지, 별표 8의2, 별표 8의3, 별표 8의4 및 별표 9의 개정규정에도 불구하고 그 정원이 기상청과 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 보고, 그에 해당하는 종전 직급의 정원은 감축된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Adjustment of Personnel Quotas Following the Abolition of Functional Positions)  In cases where there are personnel quotas that were integrated and operated pursuant to Article 26, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” among the personnel quotas of general civil servants that are increased by reducing the personnel quotas of functional civil servants due to the enforcement of this Rule, for civil servants appointed by promotion based on seniority to the integrated and operated ranks, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annexes 3 through 5, Annexe 5-2, Annexes 6 through 8, Annexe 8-2, Annexe 8-3, Annexe 8-4, and Annexe 9, such personnel quotas shall be deemed to exist separately within the Korea Meteorological Administration and its affiliated agencies while they are serving in the relevant ranks, and the personnel quotas of the corresponding former ranks shall be deemed to have been reduced.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 531, Dec. 30, 2013>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 572, Aug. 28, 2014>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 591, Jan. 12, 2015>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  As for the 9 personnel exceeding the personnel quota under this Rule due to the enforcement of Presidential Decree No. 26002, Partial Amendment to the Organizational Structure of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies, and Presidential Decree No. 26015, Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Responsible Management Agencies, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to exist separately within the Korea Meteorological Administration and its affiliated agencies until the excess personnel quota matches the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기간) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 방재기상팀 및 기상기술융합팀은 2018년 1월 11일까지 각각 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Organizations Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Disaster Prevention Meteorological Team and the Meteorological Technology Convergence Team, newly established under the enforcement of this rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies,” shall each remain in existence until January 11, 2018.

rows.source_ko: ② 제2항에 따른 존속기간까지 방재기상팀 및 기상기술융합팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 아니하는 경우에는 제2항에 따른 존속기간이 지난 날부터 방재기상팀장이 분장하는 사항은 예보정책과장이, 기상기술융합팀장이 분장하는 사항은 기상서비스정책과장이 각각 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made concerning the duties of the Heads of the Disaster Prevention Meteorology Team and Meteorological Technology Convergence Team by the end of the period under paragraph (2), from the day following the end of that period the Head of the Forecasting Policy Division shall assume the former team's duties and the Head of the Meteorological Service Policy Division shall assume the latter team's duties.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 별표 4의 개정규정에 따른 행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 정원 중 6명과 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 정원 중 3명은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2028년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 각각 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 6명과 행정서기ㆍ공업서기ㆍ기상서기ㆍ시설서기ㆍ전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 3명으로 본다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 12. 31., 2023. 12. 12., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Positions Upgraded under the Total Personnel Cost System) ① Of the positions under the amended Annex 4, six Grade 6 posts in the administrative, industrial, meteorological, facilities, computer or broadcasting and telecommunications series and three Grade 7 posts in those series shall remain in effect through December 31, 2027. From January 1, 2028, the corresponding quotas shall be deemed to be six Grade 7 posts and three Grade 8 posts in those series, respectively. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; Dec. 31, 2021; Dec. 12, 2023; Dec. 31, 2025>
② Deleted <December 31, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 4의 행정서기ㆍ공업서기ㆍ기상서기ㆍ시설서기ㆍ전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 1명은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2028년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 행정서기보ㆍ공업서기보ㆍ기상서기보ㆍ시설서기보ㆍ전산서기보 또는 방송통신서기보 1명으로 본다. <개정 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 12. 31., 2023. 12. 12., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Positions Upgraded to the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① One Administrative Clerk, Industrial Clerk, Meteorological Clerk, Facilities Clerk, Computer Clerk, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk as specified in Annex 4, which is adjusted by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027; and thereafter, the corresponding authorized number shall be deemed to be one Assistant Administrative Clerk, Assistant Industrial Clerk, Assistant Meteorological Clerk, Assistant Facilities Clerk, Assistant Computer Clerk, or Assistant Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019; Dec. 31, 2021; Dec. 12, 2023; Dec. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기간) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설된 정보보호팀은 2027년 3월 29일까지 존속한다. <개정 2021. 2. 25., 2023. 3. 28., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Information Security Team newly established pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule under Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies shall remain in existence until March 29, 2027. <Amended Feb. 25, 2021; Mar. 28, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기간까지 정보보호팀이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 아니하는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기간이 지난 날부터 정보보호팀장이 분장하는 사항은 정보통신기술과장이 분장한다. <개정 2023. 3. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made for the duties of the Information Security Team before the end of the period under paragraph (1), the Head of the Information and Communications Technology Division shall assume the Head of the Information Security Team's duties from the day after that period expires. <Amended Mar. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기간) 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 4의 행정사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 방송통신사무관 정원 중 1명은 2027년 3월 29일까지 존속하며, 2027년 3월 30일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 4의 행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명으로 본다. <개정 2021. 2. 25., 2023. 3. 28., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  One of the authorized positions for Administrative Officer, Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer specified in Annex 4, which is adjusted by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until March 29, 2027; thereafter, the corresponding authorized position shall be deemed to be one Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Meteorological Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant specified in Annex 4. <Amended Feb. 25, 2021; Mar. 28, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 수치예보활용팀은 2028년 8월 9일까지 존속한다. <개정 2024. 6. 7., 2026. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Numerical Weather Prediction Utilization Team, newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies under the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in existence until August 9, 2028. <Amended Jun. 7, 2024; Jul. 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 수치예보활용팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 수치예보활용팀장이 분장하는 사항은 수치예보기획과장이 분장한다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made for the duties of the Head of the Numerical Weather Prediction Utilization Team before the period under paragraph (1) ends, the Head of the Numerical Weather Prediction Planning Division shall assume those duties from the day after that period expires. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Radar Support Team newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies under the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in existence until October 31, 2028. <Amended Jun. 7, 2024; Jul. 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 레이더지원팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 레이더지원팀장이 분장하는 사항은 레이더운영과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made for the duties of the Radar Support Team before the period under paragraph (1) ends, the Head of the Radar Operations Division shall assume those duties from the day after the period expires.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2022년 1월 1일부터 시행한다. 다만, 다음 각 호의 사항은 2021년 12월 31일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on January 1, 2022. Provided, however, that the matters of each of the following subparagraphs shall enter into force on December 31, 2021.

rows.source_ko: 1. 환경부령 제376호 기상청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제4조제1항의 개정규정
rows.text_en: 1. Amended provisions of Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies, Ministry of Environment Decree No. 376

rows.source_ko: 2. 환경부령 제687호 기상청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제3조제1항부터 제3항까지의 개정규정
rows.text_en: 2. Amended provisions of Article 3, Paragraphs 1 through 3 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies, Ministry of Environment Decree No. 687

rows.source_ko: 3. 환경부령 제693호 기상청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조제1항부터 제4항까지의 개정규정
rows.text_en: 3. Amended provisions of Article 2, Paragraphs 1 through 4 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies, Ministry of Environment Decree No. 693

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 지진화산기술팀은 각각 2026년 12월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2024. 12. 17., 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Established under the Total Personnel Cost System) ① The Earthquake and Volcano Technology Team established under Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies upon this Rule's entry into force shall continue until December 31, 2026. <Amended Dec. 17, 2024; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 지진화산기술팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 지진화산기술팀장이 분장하는 사항은 지진화산정책과장이 분장한다. <개정 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are established regarding matters assigned by the Head of the Earthquake and Volcano Technology Team until the expiration of the term under Paragraph 1, the Head of the Earthquake and Volcano Policy Division shall assume the matters assigned by the Head of the Earthquake and Volcano Technology Team from the day following the expiration of the term under Paragraph 1. <Amended Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 종전의 환경부령 제687호 기상청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제3조제2항에 따른 정원으로서 별표 7의 개정규정에 따라 종전의 직급으로 환원되는 정원을 제외한 별표 7의 정원 12명(행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사ㆍ방송통신주사 5명 및 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 7명)은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2028년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 7의 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 5명 및 행정서기ㆍ공업서기ㆍ기상서기ㆍ시설서기ㆍ전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 7명으로 본다. <개정 2023. 12. 12., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Positions Upgraded under the Total Personnel Cost System) ① Of the 12 posts under Annex 7, excluding those reverting to their former grades under the amendment to Annex 7 pursuant to Article 3 (2) of the Addenda to Ordinance of the Ministry of Environment No. 687, five Grade 6 posts and seven Grade 7 posts in the administrative, industrial, meteorological, facilities, computer or broadcasting and telecommunications series shall continue through December 31, 2027. From January 1, 2028, the corresponding quotas shall be deemed five Grade 7 posts and seven Grade 8 posts, respectively. <Amended Dec. 12, 2023; Dec. 31, 2025>
② Deleted <February 25, 2025>
③ Deleted <Jan. 6, 2026>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 976, Feb. 22, 2022>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 989, June 17, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 6의 개정규정 및 별표 7의 개정규정은 각각 2022년 7월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Annex 6 and Annex 7 shall enter into force on July 1, 2022, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 5의3의 정원 1명(행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명)은 2027년 6월 17일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Staffing Increase under the Total Personnel Cost System) The  one additional staffing quota specified in Annex 5-3 (one Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Meteorological Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant) resulting from the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in effect until June 17, 2027. <Amended June 2, 2025>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1014, Dec. 20, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 국립기상과학원의 정원 1명(8급 1명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 국립기상과학원에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  If there is an excess number of personnel corresponding to the one personnel quota (one Grade 8 position) of the National Institute of Meteorological Sciences that is reduced by the enforcement of this Rule, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to exist separately at the National Institute of Meteorological Sciences until the excess number of personnel matches the personnel quota under this Rule.
Article 3  Deleted <June 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 4의 정원 1명(행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명)은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2028년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 4의 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 1명으로 본다. <개정 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Duration of Positions Upgraded under the Total Personnel Cost System) ① One Grade 6 post in the administrative, industrial, meteorological, facilities, computer or broadcasting and telecommunications series under Annex 4 shall remain in effect through December 31, 2027. From January 1, 2028, the corresponding quota shall be deemed one Grade 7 post in that series. <Amended Dec. 31, 2025>
② Deleted <February 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 8의2의 정원 2명(행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명, 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 1명)은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2028년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 각각 별표 8의2의 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 1명과 행정서기ㆍ공업서기ㆍ기상서기ㆍ시설서기ㆍ전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 1명으로 본다. <개정 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The two positions stipulated in Annex 8-2 that are adjusted by the enforcement of this Rule (one Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Meteorological Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant, and one Assistant Administrative Assistant, Assistant Industrial Assistant, Assistant Meteorological Assistant, Assistant Facilities Assistant, Assistant Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant) shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027; and thereafter, the corresponding positions shall be deemed to be one Assistant Administrative Assistant, Assistant Industrial Assistant, Assistant Meteorological Assistant, Assistant Facilities Assistant, Assistant Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant, and one Administrative Clerk, Industrial Clerk, Meteorological Clerk, Facilities Clerk, Computer Clerk, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk, respectively, as stipulated in Annex 8-2. <Amended Dec. 31, 2025>
④ Deleted <February 25, 2025>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1026, Mar. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 4의 정원 3명(행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명, 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 2명)은 2028년 3월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Staffing Increase under the Total Personnel Cost System)  The three positions specified in Annex 4 that are increased by the enforcement of this Rule (one Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Meteorological Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant; and two Assistant Administrative Assistants, Assistant Industrial Assistants, Assistant Meteorological Assistants, Assistant Facilities Assistants, Assistant Computer Assistants, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistants) shall remain in effect until March 31, 2028. <Amended Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 정원 4명(행정사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 방송통신사무관 1명, 행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명, 행정주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ기상주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 2명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 기상청에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas) In the event that there  is an excess of personnel corresponding to the four personnel quotas reduced by the enforcement of this Rule (one Administrative Officer, Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer; one Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Meteorological Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant; and two Assistant Administrative Assistants, Assistant Industrial Assistants, Assistant Meteorological Assistants, Assistant Facilities Assistants, Assistant Computer Assistants, or Assistant Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistants), the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to exist separately at the Korea Meteorological Administration until the excess personnel quota matches the personnel quota under this Rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1046, June 30, 2023>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of the Quota Increased by the Total Personnel Cost System)  The one position specified in Annex 4 (one Administrative Officer, Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer) increased by the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in effect until March 31, 2028. <Amended Jan. 6, 2026>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1054, Aug. 30, 2023>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 1의 개정규정 중 전주기상지청의 관할구역 부분 및 별표 1의2의 개정규정 중 광주지방기상청의 위치 부분은 2024년 1월 18일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the part regarding the jurisdiction of the Jeonju Branch Meteorological Office in the amended provisions of Annex 1 and the part regarding the location of the Gwangju Regional Meteorological Office in the amended provisions of Annex 1-2 shall enter into force on January 18, 2024.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 국립기상과학원의 정원 1명(7급 1명)과 항공기상청의 정원 1명(8급 1명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 국립기상과학원과 항공기상청에 각각 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  If there is an excess number of personnel corresponding to the quota of one person (Grade 7) at the National Institute of Meteorological Sciences and one person (Grade 8) at the Aviation Meteorological Agency that are reduced by the enforcement of this Rule, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to exist separately at the National Institute of Meteorological Sciences and the Aviation Meteorological Agency, respectively, until the excess number of personnel matches the quota under this Rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1078, Feb. 27, 2024>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1096, June 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 6 및 별표 7의 개정규정은 2024년 7월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Annex 6 and Annex 7 shall enter into force on July 1, 2024.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 특례) 기상청에 두는 공무원의 정원에 관하여는 별표 3 및 별표 4의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2024년 6월 30일까지는 별표 3의2 및 별표 4의2의 개정규정을 각각 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding personnel quotas)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 3 and Annex 4 regarding the personnel quotas of public officials in the Korea Meteorological Administration, the amended provisions of Annex 3-2 and Annex 4-2 shall apply respectively until June 30, 2024.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 4의 정원 1명(행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명)은 2027년 6월 6일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of the number of personnel increased under the total personnel cost system)  The number of personnel specified in Annex 4 that is increased by the enforcement of this rule (one administrative assistant, industrial assistant, meteorological assistant, facility assistant, computer assistant, or broadcasting and telecommunications assistant) shall remain in effect until June 6, 2027.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1100, June 25, 2024>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1124, Oct. 25, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 기후위기협력팀 및 위성개발팀은 2027년 10월 24일까지 각각 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Climate Crisis Cooperation Team and the Satellite Development Team, newly established under the enforcement of this rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies,” shall each remain in existence until October 24, 2027.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 기후위기협력팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 기후위기협력팀장이 분장하는 사항은 기후정책과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Head of the Climate Crisis Cooperation Team until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Head of the Climate Crisis Cooperation Team shall be assigned by the Head of the Climate Policy Division from the day following the expiration date under the same paragraph.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 위성개발팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 위성개발팀장이 분장하는 사항은 위성기획과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Satellite Development Team Leader until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Satellite Development Team Leader shall be assigned by the Satellite Planning Division Head from the day following the expiration date under the same paragraph.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 4의 정원 1명(행정사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ기상사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 방송통신사무관 1명)은 2027년 10월 24일까지 존속하며, 2027년 10월 25일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 4의 정원 1명(행정주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ기상주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명)으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to Total Personnel Cost System) The  authorized number of one person specified in Annex 4 (one Administrative Officer, Industrial Officer, Meteorological Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer) whose job grade is upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in effect until October 24, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding authorized number shall be deemed to be one person specified in Annex 4 (one Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Meteorological Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant).
ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1137, Dec. 17, 2024>

ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1160, Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to Total Personnel Cost System) The  five positions specified in Annex 7 (5 Administrative Officers, Industrial Officers, Meteorological Officers, Facilities Officers, Computer Officers, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers), excluding the three positions that are to be restored to the previous job grades pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 7 as part of the personnel quota under Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Meteorological Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1160), shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to be the five positions specified in Annex 7 (5 Administrative Assistants, Industrial Assistants, Meteorological Assistants, Facilities Assistants, Computer Assistants, or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistants).

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 기상문화확산팀은 2029년 10월 20일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Meteorological Culture Dissemination Team newly established under the enforcement of this rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” shall remain in existence until October 20, 2029.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 기상문화확산팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 기상문화확산팀장이 분장하는 사항은 기상서비스정책과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made for the duties of the Head of the Meteorological Culture Dissemination Team before the expiry date under paragraph (1), the Head of the Meteorological Service Policy Division shall assume those duties from the following day.
